description: ImportYeti US import records: searches companies by name and returns shipment counts, most recent shipment date, address and profile URL from ImportYeti's public search. Company search only, not individual bills of lading. Related tools on this server, for a different need: b2b_bbb when you need Better Business Bureau search: finds businesses by name; b2b_bizquest when you need businesses for sale on BizQuest: listing title, short. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
